source: MEASURED: real @elevenlabs/elevenlabs-js 2.71.0 + stubbed fetch, .ziv/logs/stage-02/survey/probe-wire.mjs -> probe-wire.out (2026-10-07). Field list and meanings: SDK api/resources/speechToText/client/requests/BodySpeechToTextV1SpeechToTextPost.d.ts and https://elevenlabs.io/docs/api-reference/speech-to-text/convert + https://api.elevenlabs.io/openapi.json (schema Body_Speech_to_Text_v1_speech_to_text_post), accessed 2026-10-07.

file.data: <Uint8Array | ArrayBuffer | Blob | File | Buffer | Readable | ReadableStream>

allFormFields.model_id: string, REQUIRED. Documented ids: scribe_v2, scribe_v2_medical (scribe_v1 deprecated). No enum in the OpenAPI schema.
allFormFields.file: binary; exactly one of file / source_url / cloud_storage_url. >= 100 ms audio; < 5.0 GB (API ref) vs 3 GB (capabilities page) - docs disagree. All major audio AND video formats.
allFormFields.source_url: string (hosted audio/video, YouTube, TikTok ...). cloud_storage_url: deprecated alias.
allFormFields.tag_audio_events: boolean, DEFAULT TRUE - (laughter), (footsteps) appear in text and as type 'audio_event' words
allFormFields.webhook / webhook_id / webhook_metadata: async mode: returns early, result goes to a dashboard-configured webhook
allFormFields.use_multi_channel / multichannel_output_: up to 5 channels, each billed at full duration; separate | combined
allFormFields.transcript_edit: natural-language post-edit instruction (<= 2000 chars), +30%, min 10 s billed
allFormFields.keyterms: list of terms to bias towards: <= 1000 terms (help center says 100), each < 50 chars and <= 5 words, no < > { } [ ] \ ; +20%; > 100 terms -> 20 s minimum billed
allFormFields.query: token: single-use token (POST /v1/single-use-token/batch_scribe) instead of the key - for browsers

expect.noFreeTextPrompt: There is no free-text context prompt. coax's TranscribeRequest.prompt has no equivalent: keyterms is a LIST of terms with a surcharge, transcript_edit is a post-processing instruction. Mapping prompt onto either changes meaning and cost.
expect.filenameMatters: Without filename/contentType the SDK names the part 'blob' and an ArrayBuffer/Uint8Array goes out with an empty type. Pass { data, filename, contentType } from coax's AudioInput (mediaType/filename), like the openai provider's toFile does.
expect.extraBodyNotPossibleThroughSdk: requestOptions.additionalBodyParameters is NOT appended to the multipart form (measured: extra_flag absent). A per-call extraBody for transcribe would need its own code path (append to the SDK request is impossible; a fetch wrapper or no-SDK call would be needed).
expect.sdkDropsStringEntityDetection: SDK only appends entity_detection / entity_redaction when they are ARRAYS (Client.js: `if (Array.isArray(...))`); a plain string such as 'all' is silently dropped. Irrelevant unless coax exposes them.
